svg.title: AWS backup and disaster recovery flow
svg.desc: Tag-driven backup plan, vault with customer-managed KMS key and Vault Lock in us-east-1, manual copy to a vault with a different KMS key in us-west-1, restore to a new EC2 instance serving HTTP 200.
